info.name: Azure Blob Storage REST Append Blobs API
Blobs
Azure Blob Storage Get blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

params.name: snapshot
params.description: The snapshot identifier. When specified, the operation returns the snapshot of the blob.

params.name: versionid
params.description: The version ID. When specified, the operation returns the specified version of the blob.

items.docs: Reads or downloads a blob from Blob Storage, including its user-defined metadata and system properties. A range of bytes can be requested using the Range header.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Put blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Creates a new blob or replaces an existing blob within a container. The type of blob to create is specified in the x-ms-blob-type header. For block blobs up to 5000 MiB, the entire content can be uploaded in a single request.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Delete blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

params.name: snapshot
params.description: The snapshot identifier. When specified, only the snapshot is deleted.

items.docs: Marks the specified blob or snapshot for deletion. The blob is later deleted during garbage collection. If soft delete is enabled, the blob can be restored within the retention period.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Get blob properties

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Returns all system properties and user-defined metadata on the blob. Does not return the blob content. Properties are returned as response headers.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Get blob metadata

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Retrieves all user-defined metadata of an existing blob or snapshot. Metadata is returned as x-ms-meta- response headers.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Set blob metadata

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Sets user-defined metadata for the specified blob as one or more name-value pairs. Existing metadata is replaced entirely.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Set blob HTTP headers

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Sets system properties defined for an existing blob such as content type, content encoding, content language, content disposition, and cache control.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Get blob tags

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Retrieves user-defined blob index tags. Tags form a secondary index that can be queried using the Find Blobs by Tags operation.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Set blob tags

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Sets user-defined blob index tags on an existing blob. Tags are key-value pairs that form a secondary index, enabling efficient querying across all blobs in a storage account.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Lease blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Establishes and manages a lock on write and delete operations for a blob. The lock can be infinite or between 15 and 60 seconds.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Snapshot blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Creates a read-only snapshot of a blob. A snapshot is a version of a blob that is captured at a point in time. Snapshots share the same blob name and are distinguished by the snapshot query parameter.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Copy blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Copies a source blob to a destination blob within the same storage account or across storage accounts. The copy operation is asynchronous and the status can be checked using Get Blob Properties.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Abort copy blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

params.name: copyId
params.description: The copy operation identifier returned by the Copy Blob response.

items.docs: Aborts a pending Copy Blob operation and leaves the destination blob with zero length and full metadata. The copy must be in a pending state.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Undelete blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Restores the contents and metadata of a soft-deleted blob and any associated soft-deleted snapshots. This is only available when soft delete is enabled and the retention period has not expired.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Set blob tier

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Sets the access tier of a block blob or page blob. For block blobs, supported tiers are Hot, Cool, Cold, and Archive. Moving a blob from Archive tier requires rehydration, which can take hours.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Set blob immutability policy

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Sets the immutability policy on a blob. Immutability policies prevent blob modification and deletion for a specified retention period. Supports unlocked and locked policy modes.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Delete blob immutability policy

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Deletes the immutability policy on a blob. The policy must be in Unlocked mode to be deleted.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Set blob legal hold

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Sets or clears a legal hold on a blob. A legal hold prevents the blob from being modified or deleted regardless of the immutability policy.
